Number of studies.evidence_source: The abstract describes a single empirical study examining the relationship between dispositional gratitude and self-reported physical health symptoms, and the mediating role of loneliness.

section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes an empirical study (referred to as 'Study X') investigating the relationship between dispositional gratitude and self-reported physical health symptoms, mediated by loneliness. In a sample of 118 adults, gratitude was found to predict fewer physical health symptoms and experiences of loneliness. Simple mediation analysis revealed that lower levels of loneliness significantly mediated the positive effect of gratitude on self-reported physical health symptoms.
